QUESTION:
What conditions is Furosemide indicated to treat?

RESPONSE:
Furosemide is indicated to treat two main conditions: (1) Edema - associated with congestive heart failure, cirrhosis of the liver, and renal disease, including the nephrotic syndrome, in both adults and pediatric patients. It is particularly useful when an agent with greater diuretic potential is desired. (2) Hypertension - in adults, furosemide may be used alone or in combination with other antihypertensive agents. However, hypertensive patients who cannot be adequately controlled with thiazides will probably also not be adequately controlled with furosemide alone.
